title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU Global Gateway Investment Facilitation and Policy Support Programme for Energy Transition in Cambodia

description.narrative: Energy is a key sector in Cambodia's green transition, with a commitment to increasing the renewable energy mix to over 70% of the national grid by 2030 as outlined in the Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 3.0. The centrepiece to this ambition is a GG investment on pumped hydro storage (with Team France), presenting a significant investment opportunity for the EU private sector. With a funding potential ranging from EUR 1-1.5 billion and supported by strong political commitment, this investment promises substantial advancements in Cambodia's energy infrastructure and green growth trajectory.Pumped hydro storage technology will integrate more renewables into Cambodia¿s grid and consequently it will make the future ASEAN Power Grid (APG) more reliable and low¿carbon. Accelerating this energy transition is critical not only for reducing electricity costs and greening the industrial sector but also for attracting more investors and positioning Cambodia as a credible trading partner for the EU. Through peer-to-peer policy dialogue (twinning) the action aims to create GG investment opportunities leveraging EU standards and expertise. Through targeted Technical Assistance, the action will create investment opportunities for the EU private sector via project origination with European Finance Institutions (EFIs). This action aligns with Cambodia's Power Sector Development Plan (PDP) 2024 and, together with the ASEAN SCOPE project, the action significantly contributes to the APG agenda, hence reinforcing the EU's role as a trusted partner. The impact will be strengthened through blending operations involving Member States, EFIs, and possibly ADB, with potential projects including a EUR 250-350 million waste-to-energy initiative, EUR 15-20 million lifeline work project, and a USD 50 million policy loan with ADB. Additionally, investments in solar-powered pumps for irrigation through the EFSD+ Window 3 (with NL), as well as targeted collaboration with CSO¿s, will further promote the comprehensive 360-degree approach of this action.
